skill_name: Generate a paragraph summarizing the Big-O notation.
workflow: Big-O notation is a mathematical notation used to describe the complexity of algorithms and to measure the speed and memory of different algorithms. It describes the time and space taken by a program to complete its task asymptotically and is expressed as a function of the size of the input. The Big-O notation simplifies the complexity of a given algorithm by providing an upper bound on the running time complexity in terms of the size of the input.
